units.source_text: 我嗅着油墨散发出来的俗世的浓烈气味，偷偷浏览了一遍报纸的大标题，急匆匆地走过了廊道。

en.t: I breathed in the strong, worldly smell given off by the printing ink, secretly skimmed the newspaper headlines, and hurried down the corridor.

units.source_text: 于是，我读到"帝都可以免遭空袭吗？"的大标题。

en.t: Then I read the headline, "Can the imperial capital be spared from air raids?"
